name: Quick reference
description: The most useful git, PowerShell and SQL commands, with search.

entries.git_amend: Add changes to the last commit
entries.git_reset_soft: Undo the last commit, keeping the changes
entries.git_restore_staged: Remove a file from the index
entries.ps_follow_file: Follow the end of a file live
entries.ps_rest_call: Call a REST API with a token
entries.sql_duplicates: Duplicates: keys that appear more than once
entries.sql_left_join: Left join, keeps rows without a match
